connection_behavior.description: Connect related points with smooth spatial trajectory curves instead of straight lines.

path_style.description: Each connection should feel like a natural flowing path through 3D space, suggesting movement, continuity, and semantic progression.

geometry.description: Each connection should be rendered as a volumetric 3D tube, not a flat line.

visual_style.description: The tube should feel spatial and dimensional, but remain visually subordinate to the points.

lighting.description: Use gentle lighting so the tube reads as a 3D form without competing with the point emphasis.

current_turn_connections.description: Connections involving the current turn should be most visible.

past_connections.description: Past connections should remain visible but slightly subdued.

future_connections.description: Future connections should remain hidden until their turn appears.

all_connections.description: After the sequence completes, show all connections with unified medium-high visibility for full trajectory review.

connection_behavior.design_intent: Connections should feel like semantic trajectories through space rather than technical connectors.
